• Proton Pump Inhibitors: rabeprazole
(AcipHex), esomeprazole (Nexium), 
lansoprazole (Prevacid), omeprazole
(Prilosec), pantoprazole (Protonix)
Note: These drugs reduce acid and may affect 
ARV absorption, particularly atazanavir; in
some cases, ARVs may speed the metabolism
of these medications, rendering them less
effective.
• H2 Blockers: nizatidine (Axid), famotidine 
(Pepcid), cimetidine (Tagamet), ranitidine 
(Zantac)
Note: These drugs reduce acid and may affect 
ARV absorption; some interactions with ARVs 
have the potential to increase toxicity (e.g., 
cimetidine increases protease inhibitor levels).
